W.note: Tidy pill with segmented progress and ETA, but the opened panel crams tiny buttons, a dim timeline and a visibly clipped bottom.

X.note: Clean teal-on-slate toast with clear status, ETA, carrier, number and full timeline, though collapsed state lacks the tracking number.

Y.note: Very compact collapsed card with ETA window and progress bar, and the open view packs carrier, number, copy, timeline with locations and actions at a readable size.

Z.note: Polished multi-package pill with tabs, switch and ETA, but the open panel is crowded and the timeline is cut off at the fold.
